name: Feature Request
description: Suggest an idea or enhancement for DockDash
title: '[FEAT]: '
labels: ['enhancement']
body:
  - type: textarea
    id: problem
    attributes:
      label: Problem / Motivation
      description: Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation?
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: solution
    attributes:
      label: Proposed Solution
      description: Describe the solution or capability you would like to see.
    validations:
      required: true
